name: X-ray microcalorimeter array operation at 50 mK (<2 uK rms) on a 3-stage ADR (Astro-H SXS)
plain_name: Hold an X-ray space-telescope detector at 50 millikelvin with a magnetic refrigerator
description: Operation of the Astro-H Soft X-ray Spectrometer 6x6 microcalorimeter array at 50 mK with <2 uK rms stability, cooled by a 3-stage adiabatic demagnetization refrigerator whose heat sink is superfluid helium or a 4.5 K JT cooler, designed for a 24 h hold time per recycle.
keywords: Hold an X-ray space-telescope detector at 50 millikelvin with a magnetic refrigerator

sources.citation: Operating Modes and Cooling Capabilities of the 3-Stage ADR Developed for the Soft-X-ray Spectrometer Instrument on Astro-H (Shirron et al.)

requirements.rationale: The array must be cooled to 50 mK.
Detector temperature stability requirement <2 uK rms.
The detector array is read out through readout wires to the cold stage.
Optional: Stage 1 was sized for a 24-hour hold time at 50 mK.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
